description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198_sym with the TVD RK2 (N 40 2, SSP stages on the uniform grid) and the refit after the projection (X 198 2): after each projection the fish takes the rigid-body motion of the projected velocity of its hull region (sixdof_cfd::refit_cfd, sixdof_obj_cfd::momentum_refit), the hull is forced again and projected again (momentum_rk::step_ssp). The 2D swimmer at L/50: 0.355 L/T in period 2 against 0.315 with X 198 1 and 0.365 with the low-storage RK3.
